BulkSend._comment: FEAT-OBI Phase 0. FAIL-SAFE default: Enabled=false. Flip to true + add pilot tenant id to AllowedTenantIds in appsettings.Production.json AFTER migration 051 is applied. MaxRecipientsPerCampaign is the kademeli pilot ceiling (5->50->100).

Export._comment: FEAT-OBI Phase 1A Plan B (Export Manager). FAIL-SAFE default: Enabled=false. Prod (appsettings.Production.json) sets Enabled=true + AllowAllTenants=true. Dedicated flag (NOT reused from ContactList) so PII-egress can be toggled independently of import.

OptOutSync._comment: Dev defaults. Real SecretKey is provided via appsettings.Production.json on the server; never commit real values here.

InternalServices._comment: Service-to-service shared secret. Real value set in appsettings.Production.json, never committed.
